api.title: API Documentation
api.description: Complete REST API reference with examples

scripts.remote:list: reasonix remote list 2>/dev/null || echo 'reasonix CLI not in PATH'
scripts.check:harness: bun run lint:bun-native:rollout && bun run format:check:harness && bun run guard:bun-first:harness && echo '' && echo 'Tip: bun run harness:report for grouped offenders + easy fixes'
scripts.standards:check: bun run url:check && bun run lint && bun run type-check
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist/ .cache/ coverage/ artifacts/bun-native-discover*.json reports/harness-gate-timing.json reports/ci-harness-timing.json reports/ci-core-timing.json reports/bun-usage-inventory.json
scripts.setup: bun run install:all && bun run build
scripts.check:brands:all: bun run brand:manifest:check && bun run check:brands && bun run check:brands:types
scripts.test:tenant-runbooks: bun test tests/harness-tenant-runbooks.test.ts tests/journey/tenant-heal.test.ts && bun run test:code-quality && bun run test:ci-deploy
scripts.test:cron: bun test tests/bun-cron.test.ts tests/harness-cron-contract.test.ts tests/bun-explicit-resource.test.ts tests/journey/cron-os-persistent.test.ts
